marketplace.name: orkastery
marketplace.description: The Orkastery plugin, built from the catalog in the orkastery/orkastery repository.

claude.description: Six-phase threads (GOAL, PLAN, GO, CHECK, SHIP, MASTER) run by the local ork CLI: each claim is re-run against the repository before it counts, and you get short decisions only when they matter.

codex.description: Six-phase threads (GOAL, PLAN, GO, CHECK, SHIP, MASTER) run by the local ork CLI: each claim is re-run against the repository before it counts, and you get short decisions only when they matter.

interface.shortDescription: Conduct coding agents with verified claims
interface.longDescription: Skills that route Codex to the local ork CLI: open a thread per task, run GOAL, PLAN, GO, CHECK, SHIP and MASTER in an isolated git worktree, re-run every claim on the real HEAD, and bring you short decisions with one recommended option. Requires the ork CLI from npm (@orkastery/cli).
defaultPrompt: Open an #Auto thread for this task
Which of my threads need a decision from me?
